name: google-search-console
description: Google Search Console: search analytics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position), URL inspection, sites and sitemaps; agent writes need an opt-in, removals are node only (OAuth or service account)

outputs.description: API result

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Search analytics
nodes.description: Clicks, impressions, CTR and position from Google Search, grouped by dimensions (query, page, country, device, date, ...) over a date range, with filters

site_url.description: Property as Search Console names it: "https://www.example.com/" (URL-prefix, with the trailing slash) or "sc-domain:example.com" (Domain property)

dimensions.description: Group-by dimensions, in order: date, hour, query, page, country, device, searchAppearance

dimension_filter_groups.description: Filters, e.g. [{"filters": [{"dimension": "query", "operator": "contains", "expression": "sepatu"}]}] (operators: equals, notEquals, contains, notContains, includingRegex, excludingRegex)

data_state.description: final (default) excludes fresh partial data; all includes it; hourly_all is needed with the hour dimension

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Inspect URL
nodes.description: Google's index status of one URL: coverage, last crawl, canonical, mobile usability, rich results, AMP

inspection_url.description: Fully-qualified URL to inspect; must be under site_url

site_url.description: Property as Search Console names it: "https://www.example.com/" (URL-prefix, with the trailing slash) or "sc-domain:example.com" (Domain property)

language_code.description: BCP-47 language for issue messages, e.g. id or en-US (default en-US)
